description: This file defines the OrderSearchCriteria class used for encapsulating various search parameters for querying orders within the OpenMRS system, including filters for patient, care setting, concepts, order types, date ranges, status, and other order-specific attributes.

classes.name: OrderSearchCriteria
classes.description: A Java class that encapsulates complex search parameters used to query orders; provides multiple constructors and getter methods for filtering based on various order attributes.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with the search criteria.

methods.name: getCareSetting
methods.description: Returns the care setting filter used in the search.

methods.name: getConcepts
methods.description: Returns the collection of concepts to filter orders.

methods.name: getOrderTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of order types to filter.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Returns the visit associated with the order search, if specified.

methods.name: getAccessionNumber
methods.description: Returns the accession number filter for exact case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: getOrderNumber
methods.description: Returns the order number filter for exact case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: getActivatedOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for orders activated on or before this date.

methods.name: getActivatedOnOrAfterDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for orders activated on or after this date.

methods.name: isStopped
methods.description: Indicates whether to filter for stopped orders.

methods.name: getAutoExpireOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for auto-expiration.

methods.name: getCanceledOrExpiredOnOrBeforeDate
methods.description: Returns the date filter for canceled or expired orders.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action filter for the order.

methods.name: getIncludeNullFulfillerStatus
methods.description: Indicates whether to include orders with null fulfiller status.

methods.name: getExcludeCanceledAndExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether to exclude canceled and expired orders.

methods.name: getExcludeDiscontinueOrders
methods.description: Indicates whether to exclude discontinue orders.

methods.name: getIncludeVoided
methods.description: Indicates whether to include voided orders.
